ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning for the prior routing decision: the query is a friendly, open-ended explanatory ask (explain a science concept conversationally). The two models are effectively tied on capability for this — Creative Generation evals differ by only 1.5 points (within variance), and both score similarly elsewhere. The deciding factor was self-reported task preference: Avocet rates open-ended generative work at 71 vs. Willet's 35, while Willet leans toward well-specified extraction/transform tasks (66) and actively disprefers open-ended work. Since preference doesn't trade against quality here, I routed to the model that prefers the task, all else equal.
